faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Pick a service, sign in and send the order form. It opens a private chat with the editor where you share footage and details.
How do I send my raw footage?
Share a Google Drive, Dropbox or similar link in the chat. File uploads are not available yet.
How long does an edit take?
Each service shows a typical delivery time. Need it faster? Ask in chat.
How many revisions do I get?
Each order includes up to 2 rounds of revisions. Extra rounds can be agreed in chat.
Payment is agreed in chat once the scope is clear. Online payment is planned.
Can I ask for something that is not listed?
Yes. Choose Custom request on the order form and describe it.
